crossRefs.note: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

translations.web: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.
translations.bsb: You will know that your tent is secure, and find nothing amiss when inspecting your home.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
translations.asv: And thou shalt know that thy tent is in peace; And thou shalt visit thy fold, and shalt miss nothing.
